use default
use Math = System.Math
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.IMAGE

recaman() -> Pipe[int] is
    let seen = SET()
    let term mut = 0
    let index mut = 0

    do
        yield term
        seen.add(term)

        index = index + 1

        let back = term - index

        term = if back > 0 /\ !seen.contains(back) then back
               else term + index
               fi
    od
si

let terms = recaman() |> take(66) |> collect()

let hops = (1..terms.count)
    |> map(n => (from = terms[n - 1], to = terms[n]))
    |> collect()

let highest =
    terms |> reduce(0, (best, term) => Math.max(best, term))

let widest =
    hops
    |> map(hop => Math.abs(hop.to - hop.from))
    |> reduce(0, (best, span) => Math.max(best, span))

let deepest = cast double(widest) / 2.0

let left = -3.0
let right = cast double(highest) + 3.0
let top = deepest + 3.0
let bottom = -(deepest + 10.0)

let scale = 4.0
let margin = 12.0

let image = IMAGE(
    cast int((right - left) * scale + 2.0 * margin),
    cast int((top - bottom) * scale + 2.0 * margin))

image.view(left, bottom, right, top, margin)

image.colour(170ub, 170ub, 170ub)
image.stroke(1.0)
image.line(0.0, 0.0, cast double(highest), 0.0)

for tick in 0::highest / 25 do
    let at = cast double(tick * 25)
    let label = "{tick * 25}"

    image.line(at, -1.5, at, 1.5)
    image.text(at, bottom + 2.5, 13.0, label, Anchor.CENTRE)
od

image.colour(30ub, 70ub, 160ub)
image.stroke(1.4)

for hop in hops |> index() do
    let (from, to) = hop.value

    let middle = cast double(from + to) / 2.0
    let radius = cast double(Math.abs(to - from)) / 2.0

    if hop.index % 2 == 0 then
        image.arc(middle, 0.0, radius, 0.0, 180.0)
    else
        image.arc(middle, 0.0, radius, 180.0, 360.0)
    fi
od

image.write("recaman.png")

image.show("recaman.png")
